name: disc-boot-smoke
description: Boots disc 1 from power-on (HLE BIOS, no input). Checks that SYSTEM.CNF's boot executable is the USA release and that the title screen is reached, and reports frames to the title and the unthrottled speed (#36). Addresses, offsets and hashes are from Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp config/us.yaml at 9411173 (reference only); see notes/36-disc-boot.md.

overlay_head.description: First 4 KiB of the SAVEMENU overlay (read-only data and code), linked at 0x801D0000

title_code.description: First 4 KiB of the title module's code in the SAVEMENU overlay: file offset 0x2B58, linked at 0x801D0000 + 0x2B58

assert.note: SCUS_941.63, USA; source claim from ff7-decomp. Reported only as matched or not.
HandleTitle loads SAVEMENU and runs its title code: the title screen. Hypothesis to confirm on Tier 2.

probes.note: Whether SAVEMENU is loaded at all (its file SHA-1 matched the decomp's on 2026-11-05).
Game-agnostic fallback: the first second-long still, non-blank picture.
The first 30 s still, non-blank picture: a stuck boot, or a static title.
